crossRefs.note: For consider him who has endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, that you don’t grow weary, fainting in…
You have forgotten the exhortation which reasons with you as with children, “My son, don’t take lightly the chastening…
Behold, you have instructed many, you have strengthened the weak hands.
Your words have supported him who was falling, You have made firm the feeble knees.
Strengthen the weak hands, and make the feeble knees firm.
All hands will be feeble, and all knees will be weak as water.
It shall be, when they ask you, ‘Why do you sigh?’ that you shall say, ‘Because of the news, for it comes! Every heart…
Then the king’s face was changed in him, and his thoughts troubled him; and the joints of his thighs were loosened, and…
She is empty, void, and waste. The heart melts, the knees knock together, their bodies and faces have grown pale.
We exhort you, brothers: Admonish the disorderly; encourage the faint-hearted; support the weak; be patient toward all.

translations.web: Therefore lift up the hands that hang down and the feeble knees,
translations.bsb: Therefore strengthen your limp hands and weak knees.
translations.kjv: Wherefore lift up the hands which hang down, and the feeble knees;
translations.asv: Wherefore lift up the hands that hang down, and the palsied knees;
